title: Football Tactics, Premier League Match Analysis & Transfer Market Sourcing
description: Specialized football English module covering tactical formations, high pressing, VAR offside decisions, and transfer market negotiations.
grammar_focus: Past Continuous vs Past Simple in Match Commentary
learning_objectives: Master modern football tactical terms (high press, low block, expected goals xG, overlapping full-backs, VAR)
Apply narrative past tenses (Past Continuous vs Past Simple) in match reporting and commentary
Eliminate Czech interference errors in sports transfer negotiations and match disputes

questions.prompt: Modern tactical systems require that modern attacking full-backs _____ upfield to provide width in the final third.

explanations.correct: Modal 'must' is followed by the bare infinitive 'overlap' without 'to'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po způsobovém slovesu 'must' následuje základní tvar slovesa: 'must overlap' (nikdy *must to overlap*).

questions.prompt: If any part of the striker's upper body _____ ahead of the second-last defender, the VAR technology flags offside.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause takes Present Simple ('is') for real operational match rules.
explanations.wrong_A: Cannot use future modal 'will' inside an if-clause.
explanations.wrong_B: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'was' would conflict with present indicative 'flags'.

questions.cz_learning_point: V podmínkových větách po 'if' se nesmí použít 'will' (*If the body will be*). Použijte přítomný čas: 'If the body is'.

questions.prompt: The goalkeeper made a stunning fingertip save _____ the defense was scrambling to clear the rebound.

explanations.correct: 'While' is a conjunction followed by a full continuous clause ('the defense was scrambling').
explanations.wrong_B: 'During' is a preposition and must be followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a verb.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Since' denotes elapsed time from a starting point or causation.

questions.cz_learning_point: Spojka 'while' se pojí s celou větou se slovesem (while the defense was scrambling), zatímco 'during' pouze s podstatným jménem.

questions.prompt: According to the player's contract, the €60m buyout clause _____ only during the summer transfer window.

explanations.correct: Passive with modal 'can be activated' correctly describes how the buyout clause is triggered.
explanations.wrong_A: Active 'can activate' is wrong; a clause does not activate itself.
explanations.wrong_B: 'can to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'can' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Trpný rod se způsobovým slovesem: 'can be activated' (může být aktivována). Doložka se sama neaktivuje.

questions.prompt: Arsenal _____ the opponent in their own penalty box when the decisive counter-attack suddenly developed.

explanations.correct: Past Continuous ('were pressing') describes the ongoing background action interrupted by 'developed'.
explanations.wrong_A: Past Simple describes single finished events rather than continuous background actions.
explanations.wrong_B: Present Simple is incorrect in a past narrative.
explanations.wrong_D: Present Perfect cannot connect to past 'developed'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Minulý průběhový čas (Past Continuous: 'were pressing') vyjadřuje probíhající děj v minulosti, do kterého vstoupil jiný jednorázový děj.

questions.prompt: The head coach substituted two central midfielders _____ the team could maintain their high pressing intensity.

explanations.correct: 'So that' is a conjunction of purpose followed by a subject and modal verb clause ('the team could maintain').
explanations.wrong_C: 'because of' is followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a finite verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: Účelová spojka 'so that' = aby (následovaná podmětem a způsobovým slovesem: 'so that the team could maintain').

questions.prompt: The aggressive pressing forwards forced the opposing center-back to _____ possession in a dangerous area.

explanations.correct: Verb structure 'force someone to do something' takes the infinitive with 'to' followed by base verb 'give away'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'give away to' is redundant and ungrammatical.
explanations.wrong_C: Past tense 'gave away' cannot follow infinitive 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'force somebody to do something': 'forced the center-back to give away possession' (ztratit míč / odevzdat míč).

questions.prompt: The winger missed a golden goalscoring opportunity _____ had an expected goals (xG) rating of 0.88.

explanations.correct: Relative pronoun 'which' correctly refers back to the antecedent inanimate noun 'opportunity'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'what' cannot act as a relative pronoun with an explicit antecedent.
explanations.wrong_D: 'whom' refers only to persons in object position.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vztažné zájmeno pro věci a situace je 'which' (která měla hodnotu xG 0,88), nikoli *what*.

questions.prompt: Judging by the defender's clear handball inside the box, the referee's decision _____ a penalty kick.

explanations.correct: 'Must be' expresses logical deduction based on clear video and visual evidence.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'can to be' is ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vyjádření jistoty a logické dedukce: 'must be a penalty' (určitě to musí být penalta). Nikdy *must to be*.

questions.prompt: The squad will not qualify for the knockout stage _____ they secure a victory in the final group fixture.

explanations.correct: 'Unless' expresses 'except if' or 'if not', stating the mandatory condition for qualification.
explanations.wrong_A: 'if' produces an illogical statement (will not qualify IF they win).
explanations.wrong_C: 'provided that' creates an illogical positive condition.
explanations.wrong_D: 'as long as' also creates an illogical condition.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Unless' = pokud ne (if not). Po 'unless' už v angličtině nenásleduje další zápor: 'unless they secure a victory'.
